assets.prompt: A restaurant service bell for a zombie survival video game. One firm press on a vintage metal countertop call bell: a crisp button click and a loud, bright DING right at the start. Sharp attack, rich metallic overtones, a clear ringing sustain decaying for two seconds. A small desk bell, urgent and attention-grabbing. Dry isolated recording. No repeated strikes, voices, zombies, music, ambience or reverb.
assets.selection: User selected Bell A for the restaurant service bell
